Container.Name: PartScout
Container.Overview: PartScout searches several electronic component suppliers at once from a web interface: prices, stock, photos and BOMs, with multiple users and a French or English interface. You need your own API keys from each supplier. Derived from Win-PartsFinder by Ian Johnston; personal and non-commercial use only (see LICENSE and NOTICE.md in the project). Generate the Master Key and the Setup Token in the Unraid terminal with: openssl rand -base64 32 Keep the Master Key somewhere safe, outside appdata: if you lose it, you will have to enter your API keys again. The image has no shell, so the Console button does not work.
Container.DonateText: PartScout is made and maintained by me, based on Win-PartsFinder by Ian Johnston. If it saves you some time, you can support my work here

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Web interface. Avoid 5060 and 5061, which browsers block.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, settings and daily backups. Unraid creates this folder. If you choose an existing one, it must belong to nobody:users (99:100).

Config.Name: Master Key
Config.Description: Encrypts your supplier API keys. Generate it with: openssl rand -base64 32. If you lose it, you will have to enter your API keys again.

Config.Name: Setup Token
Config.Description: Asked for once, when the password is created. Generate it with: openssl rand -base64 32

Config.Name: Trusted Proxy IP
Config.Description: Behind a reverse proxy: its IP address, the only source trusted for X-Forwarded-* headers. Leave empty otherwise.

Config.Name: Secure Cookie
Config.Description: always: the session cookie is only ever sent over HTTPS. Set it when PartScout is reached through HTTPS (reverse proxy). auto: Secure only when the request is HTTPS, so plain HTTP keeps working on your LAN.
